cases.title: A Quarkus request pinned in Hibernate while waiting on PostgreSQL
cases.title_zh: 通过报告评论作者公开的 Quarkus Todo 示例向真实 PostgreSQL 写入，2 批共 18 次 HTTP 创建均返回 201，独立 SQL 查询核对了已提交的数据行

findings.observation: Three delayed REST inserts pinned a Quarkus virtual thread with the pooled-lo optimizer, and the paired none controls recorded no pins. Every request returned 201 and a separate SQL query confirmed the row. PostgreSQL reported a nextval relation-lock wait in all six runs.
findings.interpretation: The selected probe wrapped Quarkus's existing factory, recording the child JDK thread ID before start and the real request dispatch stack. The same thread ID owned the JFR pin sample through PooledLoOptimizer.generate and the JDBC read. Retaining the original factory preserved the virtual-thread name. Disabling the optimizer removed the pin.
findings.limits: This restores the creation stack for the Quarkus example published after the specific Hibernate report. The reporter's production deployment was unavailable. The optimizer comparison holds the same driver, JVM and database constant.

findings_zh.observation: 通过报告评论作者公开的 Quarkus Todo 示例向真实 PostgreSQL 写入，2 批共 18 次 HTTP 创建均返回 201，独立 SQL 查询核对了已提交的数据行。Hibernate 的 pooled-lo 配置会在获取序列值时固定虚拟线程。
findings_zh.interpretation: JFR pin 事件的同一条请求栈包含 TodoResource.create、SequenceStyleGenerator.generate、PooledLoOptimizer.generate 第 61 行和 pgjdbc 的套接字读取。带 ACC_SYNCHRONIZED 的帧只有 Hibernate 这一处，独立 JVM 监视器输出也在同一行标出 monitors:1。切换为 none 后，同一驱动和数据库会话仍然在 nextval 等待，目标 pin 消失。
findings_zh.limits: 复现评论者报告的 ORM 持锁路径。使用该评论者稍后公开的 Quarkus 3.3.2 示例、Hibernate 6.2.7.Final、pgjdbc 42.6.0 与 JDK 21.0.1；原部署和输入未公开。普通请求与显式延长数据库序列锁等待分别记录。JFR 提供虚拟线程身份和物理栈。补采使用 Quarkus 的原始虚拟线程工厂和 JFR，不改变分配器配置。

cases.contribution: Stock JFR shows the JDBC pin and the virtual thread's own entry. Joining the pin to the factory's creation record by JVM thread ID recovers the earlier Quarkus caller.
cases.contribution_zh: 原生 JFR 显示 JDBC 钉住位置和虚拟线程自己的入口。用 JVM 线程 ID 拼回工厂采集的创建记录后，才能看到更早的 Quarkus 请求分派调用者。

cases.title: A stack captured after sleep omits the function that started sub
cases.title_zh: Node 18 原例的 sub 在 sleep 后打印栈时缺少 main

findings.observation: In the original Node 18 example, sub printed a stack after sleep that omitted main.
findings.interpretation: The creation stack for the same Promise recovered the line in main that started sub.
findings.limits: This identifies the initiator of one call. main did not await sub.

findings_zh.observation: Node 18 原例的 sub 在 sleep 后打印栈时缺少 main。
findings_zh.interpretation: 恢复同一个 Promise 的创建栈后，main 出现在实际发起 sub 的位置。
findings_zh.limits: 反映这次调用的发起者；main 并未等待 sub 返回。

cases.contribution: The resumed diagnostic contains sub. The Promise creation stack restores its synchronous initiator, main.
cases.contribution_zh: 恢复后的诊断栈只有 sub。拼上对应 Promise 的创建栈后，可以找回同步发起者 main。

cases.title: An indirect call hides the async caller in Node’s default stack
cases.title_zh: 原始 Node 程序经间接调用后，默认栈丢失异步上层

findings.observation: The original Node program lost its higher-level async caller after an indirect call.
findings.interpretation: Promise creation records recovered main → indirectCall → foo, identifying the application call path that the default stack omitted.
findings.limits: The V8 issue did not establish an internal cause, and the recorded chain does not identify an optimizer mechanism.

findings_zh.observation: 原始 Node 程序经间接调用后，默认栈丢失异步上层。
findings_zh.interpretation: Promise 创建路径恢复 main → indirectCall → foo；V8 工单没有给出引擎内部根因。
findings_zh.limits: 观察到调用链，不据此判定 V8 优化器机制。

cases.contribution: The early post-await diagnostic in foo omits main and indirectCall. The matching Promise creation record retains both.
cases.contribution_zh: foo 第一次 await 之后的诊断栈缺少 main 和 indirectCall。匹配到的 Promise 创建记录保留了这两个调用者。

cases.title: Recovering the creator and the current waiter of a sleeping asyncio task
cases.title_zh: 原作者四函数示例在 CPython 3.12.4 和 3.14.3 均等待十秒后返回 42

findings.observation: The four functions in the upstream example returned 42 after a ten-second wait on CPython 3.12.4 and 3.14.3. At entry to f4, the physical stack included f4 and f3. The parent task was waiting in f2. In a second experiment, two consumers awaited each other’s submitted tasks. Both children ran the same code and returned 42.
findings.interpretation: coroPerf matched two suspended samples of each child to its creation by task generation and coroutine object. In the original example the creation points to f2, where ensure_future schedules f3. In the crossed experiment, from_west created the child that read_east awaited. The other child had the reverse pairing. CPython 3.14 independently reported each current waiter and its frames.
findings.limits: The issue requests an async call graph. The crossed-task experiment is a local control. Current waiting relationships came from CPython’s task waiter pointers and, on 3.14, asyncio.capture_call_graph. The coroPerf creation records identify who scheduled each task.

findings_zh.observation: 原作者四函数示例在 CPython 3.12.4 和 3.14.3 均等待十秒后返回 42。f4 入口处的同步栈只含 f4、f3；父任务当时在 f2 中等待。
findings_zh.interpretation: 默认 coroPerf 用相同的 Task 与协程对象将 f4 的两次暂停采样连回 f2 创建 f3 任务的行。3.14 的 asyncio.capture_call_graph 独立给出 f2、f1 等待链。交叉对照中两个任务执行相同代码并返回相同值，但等待者由另一入口创建。
findings_zh.limits: 原帖是调用图功能请求。后续交叉对照是本地扩展。3.12.4 用 Task._fut_waiter 独立确认等待者，3.14.3 同时用公开调用图接口。等待关系来自这些观测，默认 coroPerf 的创建边指向发起任务。

cases.contribution: The suspended task is linked to the task creation in f2. The crossed-await control checks creator and current waiter independently.
cases.contribution_zh: 挂起现场被连回 f2 中的任务创建位置。交叉 await 对照对创建者和当前等待者做了独立核对。

cases.title: Recovering the read that failed before stream cleanup rewrote its traceback
cases.title_zh: 流清理改写异常栈后，找回真正失败的读取

findings.observation: Two loopback TCP resets fail different reads with identical error text. Both Tasks finish with the same traceback through session → wait_closed → socket receive. Debug creation stacks retain the launchers. Neither completed Task.get_stack() nor the formatted traceback, including locals, retains the failed read. Omitting the second await leaves both original read frames visible.
findings.interpretation: The file-scoped exception probe saves the first raise in _wait_for_data before cleanup, under the same Task identity recorded at creation. In the displayed run, record 5 → 19 identifies launch_profile and readexactly. Record 10 → 13 identifies launch_inventory and readuntil. Later records 22 and 16 show wait_closed for those same Tasks. The verifier checks the returned Task's coroutine object, the two catch times, and reuse of the exact exception object during cleanup.
findings.limits: The reported one-connection program and a controlled two-connection extension run on Linux with CPython 3.12.4 and 3.14.3. The 3.14.3 live call graph shows the read while it is pending. The joins preserve that information for post-failure diagnosis. All 16 first-raise joins pass with both launch orders and both read assignments.

findings_zh.observation: 两条 loopback TCP 连接分别使不同的读取失败，错误文本相同。两个 Task 结束后的异常栈都变成 session → wait_closed → socket 接收。调试创建栈还能显示发起者，Task.get_stack() 和带局部变量的最终 traceback 都缺失真正失败的读取。省略第二次 await 后，两条读取栈均保留。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 的文件范围异常探针在清理前保存 _wait_for_data 的首次抛出现场，并用同一 Task 的标识接回创建栈。页面中，记录 5 → 19 找回 launch_profile 的 readexactly，记录 10 → 13 找回 launch_inventory 的 readuntil。随后同一批 Task 的记录 22 和 16 分别出现 wait_closed。核验独立核对返回 Task 的协程对象、两次捕获时间和清理时重复抛出的同一异常对象。
findings_zh.limits: 在 Linux 上用 CPython 3.12.4 和 3.14.3 运行原单连接程序和受控的双连接实验。3.14.3 的实时调用图能显示仍在等待的读取，拼接保留的是故障结束后需要的历史信息。两种启动顺序和两种读取分配共 16 条首次抛出拼接均通过核对。

cases.contribution: Two final tracebacks point to stream cleanup. The saved first-raise stacks identify the two failed reads, and their Task creation records identify the distinct callers.
cases.contribution_zh: 两条最终异常栈都指向流清理。首次抛出时保留的栈指出两个真正失败的读取，再拼回各自的 Task 创建栈，就能确定不同的发起者。

cases.title: Garbage collection destroys a pending task waiting on an isolated Future
cases.title_zh: 孤立 Future 上等待的 Task 在触发 GC 后被销毁；保留强引用时没有销毁诊断

findings.observation: A task waiting on an isolated Future produced a destruction diagnostic after garbage collection, while keeping a strong reference suppressed it.
findings.interpretation: GDB identified the pending task passed to TaskObj_finalize, and the Python graph supplied its creation identity, consistent with collection of an unreachable cycle.
findings.limits: The original app was unpublished. The local test covers the lifecycle mechanism, and GDB supplied the internal GC path.

findings_zh.observation: 孤立 Future 上等待的 Task 在触发 GC 后被销毁；保留强引用时没有销毁诊断。
findings_zh.interpretation: GDB 的 TaskObj_finalize 实参对应实际 pending Task，Python 图补充创建任务身份，支持不可达循环的解释。
findings_zh.limits: 原应用未公开，本地仅复现生命周期机制；GC 内部路径来自外部调试器。

cases.contribution: Finalization evidence identifies the pending task, and the identity-matched capture traces the task to its creation.
cases.contribution_zh: 终结现场识别出仍未完成的任务，再通过匹配实例的采集记录追溯它的创建位置。

cases.title: A cached async call loses its caller from the live stack
cases.title_zh: 原作者的 inspect.stack 示例在发布版和作者分支的父提交只打印 bar

findings.observation: On 2.0.4 and the experimental branch’s parent, inspect.stack() showed only bar. Directly awaiting it also showed foo and main, as did the propagated exception traceback in the second example.
findings.interpretation: A cache miss created a child Task for bar, whose creation stack identified foo and main and distinguished its first caller from four other waiters sharing the result.
findings.limits: The issue concerned logging, and the experimental direct-await branch had a separate cleanup error.

findings_zh.observation: 原作者的 inspect.stack 示例在发布版和作者分支的父提交只打印 bar。相同输入在直接 await 方案打印 bar、foo、main。作者第二个例子中，发布版运行时栈缺上层调用，异常传播完毕的 traceback 则包含这三个函数。
findings_zh.interpretation: 命中前缓存包装器为 bar 单独 create_task，函数内检查的是子 Task 的当前栈。coroPerf 在原程序中把该子 Task 执行段连到含 foo 和 main 的创建栈。并发时只把共享计算归到确实创建它的首个调用，其他四个等待者通过各自的结果记录核对。
findings_zh.limits: 原作者将其作为日志需求讨论。使用其公开的两个脚本和两个实验提交，发布版取同期 2.0.4。SQLite 和双入口是本地对照。直接 await 分支另在清理列表值时遇到 later_call 属性错误；该现象归在本例的对照记录内。

cases.contribution: The active stack shows bar. Its child-task creation stack recovers foo and main and identifies the first caller among several waiters.
cases.contribution_zh: 当前栈显示 bar。拼回子任务的创建栈后可恢复 foo 和 main，并从多个等待者中区分最早的发起者。

cases.title: Starlette cancels a background task after the client disconnects
cases.title_zh: 原始 Starlette 应用在客户端断开后取消仍在运行的后台任务

findings.observation: In the reporter’s Starlette app, a client disconnect cancelled a background task that was still running.
findings.interpretation: The affected task ran through BaseHTTPMiddleware into the background _sleep call, where it received cancellation. The linked fix removed that downstream cancellation.
findings.limits: Verified with the supplied middleware and a local connection.

findings_zh.observation: 原始 Starlette 应用在客户端断开后取消仍在运行的后台任务。
findings_zh.interpretation: 受影响任务从 BaseHTTPMiddleware 进入后台 _sleep 并收到取消，关联修复移除了这类下游取消。
findings_zh.limits: 测试针对给定中间件与本地连接。

cases.contribution: The task creation link connects the request middleware to the background execution that received cancellation.
cases.contribution_zh: 任务创建关系把请求中间件和收到取消的后台执行连在一起。

cases.title: A WebSocket subscription task remains pending at shutdown
cases.title_zh: 原始 WebSocket 示例停机时仍有 notifications_handler 在 subscribe 中等待

findings.observation: In the original WebSocket example, notifications_handler was still waiting in subscribe during shutdown.
findings.interpretation: The sampled stack and cancellation point both identified the outstanding subscription task.
findings.limits: The replay used the first public example and an external WebSocket client. The later implementation’s suggested close(1001) handshake was not observed.

findings_zh.observation: 原始 WebSocket 示例停机时仍有 notifications_handler 在 subscribe 中等待。
findings_zh.interpretation: 采样和取消点定位到尚未结束的订阅任务；未观测最后建议的 close(1001) 握手。
findings_zh.limits: 原始第一个示例与外部 WebSocket 驱动；后续解决方案属于不同实现。

cases.contribution: Joining the pending subscription stack to request-task creation identifies which request was still live at shutdown.
cases.contribution_zh: 将仍在等待的订阅栈拼回请求任务的创建处，可以确定服务关闭时仍存活的是哪个请求。

cases.title: Cancellation during async connection cleanup leaves a pool checkout outstanding
cases.title_zh: SQLAlchemy 1.4.37 原始异步退出逻辑被取消后，真实 PostgreSQL 连接未归还池

findings.observation: On SQLAlchemy 1.4.37, cancelling the original async exit path left a real PostgreSQL connection checked out.
findings.interpretation: Pool checkout and return records placed cancellation between __aexit__ and close and provided a comparison with the shielded fix. The same Task created by main borrowed the connection and received cancellation during close. The pool recording identifies its checked-out connection.
findings.limits: The only change to the original workload was the private PostgreSQL address.

findings_zh.observation: SQLAlchemy 1.4.37 原始异步退出逻辑被取消后，真实 PostgreSQL 连接未归还池。
findings_zh.interpretation: 在 __aexit__ → close 之间发生取消，池的借出与归还记录可与 shield 修复版对照。
findings_zh.limits: 仅把原逻辑的数据库地址替换为私有 PostgreSQL。

cases.contribution: The cleanup sample links back to the same Task created by main. Pool records then identify the matching checked-out connection left by the cancellation.
cases.contribution_zh: 把清理现场连回 main 创建的同一个任务。连接池记录进一步核对出取消后遗留的已借出连接。

cases.title: Which Kotlin caller received the gRPC status exception?
cases.title_zh: 同一 stub 的两个 sayHello 并发挂起调用可送出完全相同的 protobuf 请求

findings.observation: Two separate coroutine Jobs invoked the same generated unary method on one stub. In the simultaneous-failure trial the server received identical protobuf bytes, and both RPCs returned UNAVAILABLE with the description “io exception”. Both original throwables had callback stacks ending at the gRPC client and omitted the application call. Two batches sent 64 real RPCs.
findings.interpretation: The continuation handed to GreeterCoroutineStub.sayHello contained the actual Kotlin Job. Its identity joined the application coroutine’s creation site to the failure at ClientCalls.kt line 295. The independent await checks used JVM reference equality for the throwable. This separated the profile call at MatchedCalls.kt line 11 from the inventory call at line 15, including when both calls carried the same message and the server reversed its reply order.
findings.limits: The service deliberately emitted the reported status over a real localhost HTTP/2 connection. The report supplied no application or version lock. These traces answer the caller and generated-method questions. Determining the underlying cause of a production network failure requires additional transport or server evidence.

findings_zh.observation: 同一 stub 的两个 sayHello 并发挂起调用可送出完全相同的 protobuf 请求。双失败时客户端收到两个不同的异常对象，原始栈均从 Status.asException 和 ClientCalls.kt 第295行的 onClose 开始，两处业务调用均未出现。
findings_zh.interpretation: 在生成 stub 的续体参数上读取实际 Job 的弱身份 ID，对应到同一 Job 的创建与失败完成栈。即使方法、消息和错误相同，仍能区分 profile 在第11行和 inventory 在第15行发起的挂起调用。
findings_zh.limits: 报告没有可运行应用和精确依赖锁。本地使用上游协议与报告时期版本，服务端显式发出所述状态。调用方和调用点可直接确定，真实生产环境为何出现网络异常需要服务端证据。

cases.contribution: Captured Kotlin Job identities connect the two failure samples to their respective launch sites, even with identical messages and reversed reply order.
cases.contribution_zh: 用采集到的 Kotlin Job 身份，将两处失败分别匹配到各自的启动位置。消息相同、响应顺序反转时也能区分两次调用。

cases.title: Kotlin Future bridges lose the caller of a failed request
cases.title_zh: 原 JUnit 程序运行六项测试，普通与采集模式各失败两项，安装 DebugProbes 后六项全过

findings.observation: Two of the six original JUnit tests failed both with and without capture. All six passed after DebugProbes was installed.
findings.interpretation: Job creation and completion records tied the two requestSuspend failures to their respective async and launch callers, the locations DebugProbes recovered. The collector and an independent continuation probe agreed on each failed Job and throwable for the async and launch cases.
findings.limits: The replay used the original compiled test classpath and covered these two Future bridges.

findings_zh.observation: 原 JUnit 程序运行六项测试，普通与采集模式各失败两项，安装 DebugProbes 后六项全过。
findings_zh.interpretation: 上游用 DebugProbes 恢复了异步请求的调用位置，受影响录制中的 Job 创建与完成记录也分别把两个 requestSuspend 失败定位到对应的 async 和 launch 测试调用方。
findings_zh.limits: 原测试套件和对应已编译 classpath；两个失败分别来自 async 和 launch 的 future 桥接。

cases.contribution: Job lifecycle joins attribute the identical requestSuspend failures to the separate async and launch callers.
cases.contribution_zh: 沿 Job 生命周期将两个相同的 requestSuspend 失败分别连回 async 和 launch 的发起者。

cases.title: A Kotlin exception after delay omits secondCall from the JVM stack
cases.title_zh: 原帖 JUnit 方法中，delay 恢复后的异常只显示 crashCall，断言要求的 secondCall 缺失

findings.observation: In the reporter’s JUnit method, the exception stack showed crashCall after resumption but omitted secondCall, so the original assertion failed.
findings.interpretation: The same Job’s continuation chain retained secondCall and firstCall. Using the reporter’s scoped crashCall restored both callers in the ordinary exception stack and made the assertion pass. The throwing continuation belongs to the same BlockingCoroutine Job created by the test’s runBlocking call.
findings.limits: Ran the public test on Kotlin 1.4.31 and kotlinx.coroutines 1.4.3. The original versions and production futures chain were unspecified.

findings_zh.observation: 原帖 JUnit 方法中，delay 恢复后的异常只显示 crashCall，断言要求的 secondCall 缺失。
findings_zh.interpretation: 在断言失败的原方法上，续体抛出点和同一 Job 的 callerFrame 链分别定位到 crashCall 及其调用者 secondCall、firstCall。只替换原帖给出的 scoped 版 crashCall，普通 JVM 异常栈就能跨恢复边界显示两层调用，原断言通过，与维护者解释吻合。
findings_zh.limits: 原样执行公开的最小 JUnit 方法与挂起函数，仅补包名、测试类和 imports。报告未指定版本，本次使用 Kotlin 1.4.31 / kotlinx.coroutines 1.4.3；实际生产 futures 链未公开。

cases.contribution: The throw sample and its continuation chain are joined to the runBlocking Job; this recovers the caller path across suspension.
cases.contribution_zh: 将抛异常时的续体栈连回 runBlocking 创建的 Job，恢复挂起前的调用路径。

cases.title: Identical Trio socket-read frames obscure which child was cancelled
cases.title_zh: 按发帖日期取 Trio 的当时源码和 Python 3.6.2

findings.observation: Three runs of the original single-task example retained Cancelled’s implicit context. With two readers at the same line, a parent nursery timeout surfaced at fail_at.
findings.interpretation: Matching each Task and coroutine to its cancellation and creation site identified start_profile or start_catalog correctly in all six captures when the nonresponding side was swapped.
findings.limits: The public issue was a diagnostics discussion. The two-socket nursery was a local extension on historical Trio and Python 3.6.2.

findings_zh.observation: 按发帖日期取 Trio 的当时源码和 Python 3.6.2。公开单任务示例在三次原始运行中均保留了 Cancelled 的隐式上下文。两条真实本地 socket 读取共用同一函数时，父 nursery 超时的异常由 fail_at 抛出。
findings_zh.interpretation: 单任务的默认 Python 异常格式本身就能显示阻塞位置。父作用域超时时，标准库的格式化只展示父作用域，Trio 自带的异常打印能展示子任务的共同读取行。两个任务共用这行代码，打印结果无法区分创建入口。按 Task 与协程对象把套接字读取、实际收到的 Cancelled 和创建栈相连，交换不回复的一侧后，6 次父作用域采集均指向对应的 start_profile 或 start_catalog。两边均回包时没有取消。
findings_zh.limits: 原帖是诊断功能讨论，未附多任务应用。双 socket 与 nursery 场景是本地受控扩展。历史提交依发帖时间选择。采集使用该版本公开的 Trio Instrument 回调和 Python 异常跟踪。原始栈由 coroPerf CLI 分析。

cases.contribution: Creation-to-cancellation attribution identifies which of two similarly executing tasks came from the unresponsive branch.
cases.contribution_zh: 把取消现场连回任务的创建位置，区分执行路径相似的两个任务，定位无响应的一侧。

cases.title: An uniterated inference stream leaves a client warning
cases.title_zh: 相同 loopback HTTP 端点上的两条未迭代流产生一条客户端告警；修复版零条

findings.observation: Two streams requested from the same loopback endpoint and left uniterated produced one client warning on the affected build and none after the fix.
findings.interpretation: Session and response identities tied the warning to submit_alpha and matched the independently recorded release order, and the shared URL and warning text could not distinguish the callers.
findings.limits: The test used aiohttp 3.10.5, controlled the release order, and triggered garbage collection. Production frequency was not measured.

findings_zh.observation: 相同 loopback HTTP 端点上的两条未迭代流产生一条客户端告警；修复版零条。
findings_zh.interpretation: 通过 session/response 身份把告警归给 submit_alpha 并与独立释放顺序核对；仅凭同样的 URL 和告警文本无法区分两个创建者。
findings_zh.limits: aiohttp 3.10.5，指定释放顺序并触发 GC；未测生产告警频率。

cases.contribution: Two requests shared a URL. The captured task lineage and response identities let the warning be attributed to submit_alpha.
cases.contribution_zh: 两个请求使用同一 URL。沿任务创建关系并核对响应对象身份，可以将告警归到 submit_alpha。

cases.title: Mongoose validation errors lose the application’s save call
cases.title_zh: 原帖的无效文档在 8.12.1 产生 ValidationError，其原始错误栈越过不了校验回调，缺失 runDemo 中的 doc.save 调用行；9.0.0 的原始错误栈保留该行及中间调用

findings.observation: The original ValidationError on 8.12.1 omitted runDemo’s doc.save line, while 9.0.0 retained it and passed all 15 upstream stack assertions versus 3 on the older version.
findings.interpretation: The creation stack connected runDemo line 22 to validation through model.save and its pre-save hooks, although the error itself had only four frames and began at Document.invalidate.
findings.limits: The old printer could already show the caller. Tests used a separate database and a 20-frame limit. The version comparison spans multiple changes.

findings_zh.observation: 原帖的无效文档在 8.12.1 产生 ValidationError，其原始错误栈越过不了校验回调，缺失 runDemo 中的 doc.save 调用行；9.0.0 的原始错误栈保留该行及中间调用。
findings_zh.interpretation: 受影响图在创建任务时记录 runDemo 第 22 行 → model.save → Kareem.execPre → validateBeforeSave → validate，错误样本只含 Document.invalidate 等四帧。样本归属到同一行注册的 catch 继续执行任务。独立运行 15 个上游用例，栈断言从 3/15 变为 15/15。重复键 save 在两版都被 MongoDB 拒绝且仅保留 A；只有 9.0.0 的错误栈含 saveServerErrors。
findings_zh.limits: 旧版打印器本身已经能显示调用行；受影响的是实际错误栈和验证到调用点的路径。重复键 updateOne 两版均已保留调用点，作为对照。15 个冻结测试采用独立数据库并沿用发帖者的 20 帧上限；未覆盖原帖提出的每一种操作。版本对照包含多项改动，不能将全部变化单独归于一个提交。

cases.contribution: The validation stack starts at Document.invalidate. The Promise creation record recovers the originating model.save call in runDemo.
cases.contribution_zh: 校验栈起于 Document.invalidate。拼上 Promise 创建记录可以找回 runDemo 中发起的 model.save。

cases.title: Awaiting a Mongoose query hides the ObjectId cast caller
cases.title_zh: 直接 await Mongoose 查询时，非法 ObjectId 的转换错误缺少原始调用点

findings.observation: Directly awaiting a query with an invalid ObjectId produced a cast error whose stack omitted the application call site.
findings.interpretation: The promise creation stack showed Query.then calling exec internally, while calling exec explicitly on the same input exposed the application stack.
findings.limits: Casting happened before the driver could send a database query.

findings_zh.observation: 直接 await Mongoose 查询时，非法 ObjectId 的转换错误缺少原始调用点。
findings_zh.interpretation: 上游指出直接 await 会让 Query.then 在内部调用 exec，受影响版本的 Promise 创建栈实测到了这条委托路径。 相同输入改走显式 exec，得到可比较的应用栈。
findings_zh.limits: 查询在驱动发送前进行类型转换，本例没有后端查询。

cases.contribution: The creation record shows Query.then starting exec internally and recovers the application context missing from the error.
cases.contribution_zh: 创建记录显示 Query.then 在内部启动 exec，并恢复错误栈里丢失的应用调用上下文。

cases.title: Axios errors hide which application call issued a request
cases.title_zh: 同一本地账单路由返回 HTTP 500

findings.observation: Two awaited GETs to the same local billing route returned HTTP 500, and both errors matched the report’s seven frames while omitting both application callers.
findings.interpretation: The creation stacks at axios.get, matched through Promise, Error, and ClientRequest identities to the server receipts, distinguished the two callers.
findings.limits: Axios 0.19.0 and Node 12.6.0 were inferred from frame locations. A separate probe established object identity.

findings_zh.observation: 同一本地账单路由返回 HTTP 500。两个 await 调用的原生错误都逐帧匹配首帖的七个函数及行列号，两个应用调用者均缺失。
findings_zh.interpretation: 图在 axios.get 返回时保留各自的应用栈。通过同一返回 Promise、同一 Error 和同一 ClientRequest，对应到外层拒绝及服务端回执，缺失的两个调用者均可区分。
findings_zh.limits: 首帖未提供包或 Node 锁文件。0.19.0 是发帖前发布包中唯一匹配三个 Axios 行号的版本，12.6.0 也匹配四个 Node 内部帧。使用本地普通 GET。对象关系由小型探针采集，旧 Node 的 unhandled-rejection 样本本身未识别 Promise ID。

cases.contribution: Matching Promise, Error, and ClientRequest identities lets the two reports be traced to separate axios.get callers.
cases.contribution_zh: 对齐 Promise、Error 和 ClientRequest 身份后，可以把两条错误记录分别追溯到对应的 axios.get 调用者。

cases.title: Awaiting a Knex query drops the caller from its error stack
cases.title_zh: 原帖代码对同一张缺失的 userss 表执行 SELECT，Bluebird 的 .then 栈保留 test 第 18 行，而 await 的未处理拒绝保留三段 previous event 却丢失 test

findings.observation: For the same missing userss table, Bluebird’s then stack retained line 18 of test, while await retained three previous-event sections and lost test.
findings.interpretation: The Promise delivered to unhandledRejection matched its async_hooks creation in test. A separate configuration control restored both caller stacks when the builder’s wrapper also enabled asyncStackTraces.
findings.limits: The graph identified the function entry only. The later commenter’s application was unavailable.

findings_zh.observation: 原帖代码对同一张缺失的 userss 表执行 SELECT，Bluebird 的 .then 栈保留 test 第 18 行，而 await 的未处理拒绝保留三段 previous event 却丢失 test。
findings_zh.interpretation: 在 await 的受影响图中，Node 传给 unhandledRejection 的原生 Promise 与 async_hooks 初始化对象匹配。样本经同一 Promise 的创建栈连回 test 函数入口，补上错误栈缺失的应用归属。后续评论另做配置对照：两端执行器均启用 asyncStackTraces，仅在创建 builder 的包装实例上也启用时，两条错误栈均恢复本地调用函数。
findings_zh.limits: 原帖的 test 函数入口与具体 SQL 行分开，图只直接恢复入口。Node 9 采集臂安装拒绝监听器，原生默认告警文本以无探针运行保存。Bluebird .then 的通知没有原生 Promise 身份。较晚评论者未公开应用及版本，本地使用其完整 runner 覆盖函数的两个显式路由分支；两个数据库共用一台本地服务，未运行副本复制。

cases.contribution: The rejection's Promise identity identifies the creation stack in the application test where the missing async caller originated.
cases.contribution_zh: 通过发生拒绝的 Promise 身份，可以恢复应用测试中缺失的异步调用者。

cases.title: A duplicate-key error loses its caller on Sequelize’s create path
cases.title_zh: 原帖作者在评论中给出的重复用户名示例：直接 create 的错误栈止于 Query.formatError、Query.run 及微任务；相同唯一约束经 findOrCreate 时保留 model.save、Function.findOrCreate 和测试调用行

findings.observation: In the reporter’s duplicate-username example, create showed only Query.formatError, Query.run and microtasks, while findOrCreate retained model.save, findOrCreate and the test line.
findings.interpretation: The second create’s task linked the application call at line 9 to the catch at line 11. Plain INSERT formatted the driver error there, while findOrCreate returned it through a SQL wrapper.
findings.limits: This covers the public PostgreSQL example with a minimal local model. The opening post’s length-validation model was unavailable.

findings_zh.observation: 原帖作者在评论中给出的重复用户名示例：直接 create 的错误栈止于 Query.formatError、Query.run 及微任务；相同唯一约束经 findOrCreate 时保留 model.save、Function.findOrCreate 和测试调用行。
findings_zh.interpretation: 受影响图在第二次 create 创建任务时记录 runFixture 第 9 行、model.save、PostgresQueryInterface.insert 及 Query.run；另一条同任务创建至错误样本的边定位第 11 行的 catch。findOrCreate 的 SQL 包装函数返回 sequelize_caught_exception，而普通 INSERT 的驱动错误走 catch 中的 formatError。
findings_zh.limits: full_local 对应有公开代码的 PostgreSQL 子例。首帖的 length 校验来自未公开模型；此前的校验实测保留在历史图，不能据此声称 6.10.0 首次修好了模型校验。测试用独立数据库并补全最小模型定义。

cases.contribution: Stitching the second create call to its catch reconnects the lost application call site to the driver-error path.
cases.contribution_zh: 将第二次 create 的创建栈拼到 catch 现场，把错误栈中缺失的应用调用行连到驱动报错路径。

cases.title: A MySQL query error loses its async caller
cases.title_zh: 两个应用入口经同一 helper 访问不存在的表，mysql2 原生错误栈没有查询入口

findings.observation: Two entry points queried a missing table through the same helper, and neither caller appeared in the affected driver’s native error stack.
findings.interpretation: Separate query promises linked the errors to readAccount and readInvoice, and capturing an Error at query time preserved both callers in the 1.4.0 stacks.
findings.limits: The test used direct promise queries against MySQL 8. The pooled-connection variant was not traced.

findings_zh.observation: 两个应用入口经同一 helper 访问不存在的表，mysql2 原生错误栈没有查询入口。
findings_zh.interpretation: 上游确认在查询处创建 Error 可保留调用点，受影响驱动中两个相同缺表错误通过不同查询 Promise 分别追到 readAccount 和 readInvoice。 原版和 1.4.0 直连 MySQL 8，健康查询成功，修复版两条错误的原生栈各自出现调用者。
findings_zh.limits: 验证直连 Promise 查询；评论区的池连接变体未作同等归因。

cases.contribution: The two query Promise identities tie similar failures to readAccount and readInvoice separately.
cases.contribution_zh: 两次查询的 Promise 身份将相似的错误分别归到 readAccount 和 readInvoice。

cases.title: Got’s connection timeout stack omits the downloader’s application caller
cases.title_zh: 两个调用点同时通过已发布的 Electron 下载器发起 HTTPS GET，只给其中一路设置 200 ms 连接限时，另一路 2000 ms

findings.observation: Across two runs, only the download with the 200 ms connection budget failed, and all 13 error frames matched the report after path normalization while omitting the SDK and application callers.
findings.interpretation: Promise identities and the active timer identified the local caller and connect-phase abort, and switching the 200 ms and 2,000 ms budgets moved the failure to the other caller.
findings.limits: The test used a published Electron downloader with locally chosen call sites. The original dependencies, domain setup, and timeout source were unavailable.

findings_zh.observation: 两个调用点同时通过已发布的 Electron 下载器发起 HTTPS GET，只给其中一路设置 200 ms 连接限时，另一路 2000 ms。两轮交换限时的无探针运行均只丢失短限时的一路；归一化模块安装目录后，错误标题、13 个帧的函数、文件和行列与报告一致，栈中缺少 SDK 和应用调用点。
findings_zh.interpretation: 原生错误已经能回答“哪个 URL 失败”。新增身份记录还能回答“哪一个本地调用返回的 Promise 收到该错误”，并从 timer 栈定位到 connect 阶段的终止请求处。将 200 ms 预算移到另一个版本后，服务器收到的路径、被拒绝的两个 Promise 和正在执行的计时器随之切换。
findings_zh.limits: 原项目的依赖、domain 环境和限时来源未公开，本地 SDK 和两个调用点由实验选定。计时器仅作诊断，返回 Promise 的下游反应回调在独立 ID 上运行，空帧 settlement 保留结局。包捕获通过成功 GET 的端口排除另一连接，使用用户态采样时间。

cases.contribution: Promise and timer identities recover which initiating caller hit its connect-phase deadline in the timing control.
cases.contribution_zh: 用 Promise 和计时器身份核对超时现场，找出触发连接阶段时限的发起者。

cases.title: TypeORM’s SQL Server error stack starts in the query runner
cases.title_zh: 真实 SQL Server 的 YYY int NOT NULL 列收到参数 NULL，报 515、EREQUEST

findings.observation: On TypeORM 0.3.24, a NULL for a required integer column returned SQL Server error 515 (EREQUEST) with a stack starting at SqlServerQueryRunner.js:204. A valid write was independently read back.
findings.interpretation: Promise identities connected each runner.query rejection and its await continuation to the originating importOrders or refreshCatalog call, even though both used the same SQL and produced the same error.
findings.limits: The reporter’s Nest app and schema were unavailable. Two local callers exercised the reported versions, driver, query pattern and constraint. The intervals use V8’s Promise init and settlement notifications on the same Node clock. A second hook captured the rethrow stack during the settlement notification.

findings_zh.observation: 真实 SQL Server 的 YYY int NOT NULL 列收到参数 NULL，报 515、EREQUEST。报告版本 0.3.24 的原生栈从 SqlServerQueryRunner.js:204 开始，缺少应用调用行。合法写入可由独立连接读回。
findings_zh.interpretation: 用运行时记录的 Promise 身份区分两个应用调用。应用返回的实际 async Promise 的创建帧是 importOrders 或 refreshCatalog，V8 报告它结束时的栈仍位于同一函数的 rethrow。此时正执行的 await 续体由 runner.query 返回的具体 Promise 触发。核对该续体中的原生错误帧、错误对象及两个请求的独立结果，可以把相同 SQL 和错误信息归回各自的调用行。
findings_zh.limits: 报告者的 Nest 应用、实体和真实表名未发布。程序使用其 Node 和 TypeORM 版本、SQL Server 驱动、查询方式和同类非空约束。两个入口以及查询返回、异常打印和 V8 结束时的观测点为本地对照。服务端事件独立验证错误与 SQL；未将具体服务端会话推作 JavaScript 的协程创建者。

cases.contribution: The same SQL produces the same error text in two callers. Matching each Promise and await continuation distinguishes importOrders from refreshCatalog.
cases.contribution_zh: 两个调用者执行相同 SQL 并得到相同报错。拼接各自 Promise 的创建栈和 await 恢复栈，可以区分 importOrders 和 refreshCatalog。

cases.title: Objection’s QueryBuilder loses application callers from async error stacks
cases.title_zh: 通过 Objection QueryBuilder 执行坏 SQL 后，两个调用者在原生异常栈中消失

findings.observation: Two application callers disappeared from native exceptions raised by failing QueryBuilder queries. Healthy queries against the same PostgreSQL server each returned one row.
findings.interpretation: At the custom thenable boundary, the identities of the two query objects linked their application creation sites to the corresponding rejections in handleExecuteError.
findings.limits: The links came from a dedicated WeakMap probe and establish query-object identity only.

findings_zh.observation: 通过 Objection QueryBuilder 执行坏 SQL 后，两个调用者在原生异常栈中消失。
findings_zh.interpretation: 上游定位到自定义 QueryBuilder 的 thenable 边界，实测两个查询对象的真实身份分别把应用创建点与 handleExecuteError 中的拒绝关联起来。 同一 PostgreSQL 服务器的健康查询各返回一行，raw 驱动错误栈与 ORM 错误栈有差异。
findings_zh.limits: 查询对象关联来自专用 WeakMap 探针；它不代表通用 Promise 父边。

cases.contribution: At the custom thenable boundary, query-object identity reconnects each rejection to its own application creation site.
cases.contribution_zh: 在自定义 thenable 边界，用查询对象身份将各次拒绝连回对应的应用创建位置。

cases.title: An upsert can leave lastrowid pointing to another project
cases.title_zh: 提交并重新打开数据库，主键 1 的名称确已更新；原评论的 >0 分支在返回 2 时会把另一项目当作目标

findings.observation: Each run used one SQLite connection for 24 concurrent upserts. Twelve new projects got their own row IDs. Of the twelve updates, one read zero and eleven read a positive ID belonging to another project. Reopening the database confirmed the row actually updated in every case.
findings.interpretation: The capture joins each asyncio task created by gather in measure to its lastrowid getter and the value it returned. For example, project 12 returned 0 and committed to row 12. The original database controls explain how that can happen. A conflict update preserves the connection’s last successful insert ID, which CPython copies into the cursor at execution time.
findings.limits: Task identities come from the local concurrent workload that used the published SQL. The upstream comment used synchronous sqlite3. Two traced runs each matched all 24 tasks. Diagnosing the stale ID also required the insert history and the committed rows.

findings_zh.observation: 提交并重新打开数据库，主键 1 的名称确已更新；原评论的 >0 分支在返回 2 时会把另一项目当作目标。
findings_zh.interpretation: CPython 在 execute 时将本连接 sqlite3_last_insert_rowid() 存入该游标。project=101 的冲突更新保留同连接上次成功插入的 ID 2，按大于零直接返回就会指错行。常规插入 project=303 得到的 2 则正确。反向交错时，连接寄存值已变 3，较早执行更新的游标仍为 0。唯一键查询与磁盘行确定了返回值所指的项目。
findings_zh.limits: 完整复现范围为公开评论的参数化 SQL 与回退代码。键值、种子行及两任务顺序由本地测试设置。报告人的 Windows 10 项目及 SQLite 实例未提供；本地 SQLite 版本取自 CPython 3.8.5 的 Windows 构建清单。栈佐证正确游标上的读取，判定错误目标需要 SQL 历史和持久化行。 协程来源来自本地并发调用，原评论的标准库代码为同步调用。

cases.contribution: Task joins identify which concurrent gather callers received each lastrowid observation, so the reported values can be compared with the correct committed rows.
cases.contribution_zh: 通过任务拼接找出每次 lastrowid 观测来自哪个 gather 子任务，进而用正确的已提交数据行核对返回值。

cases.title: Concurrent update_or_create returns the other caller’s value
cases.title_zh: 两个异步调用同时为同一商品键指定不同值

findings.observation: Two tasks supplied different defaults for the same missing PostgreSQL row. On the observed parent run, the first task created the row with a. The caller that requested b also received a, and an independent database read found a. No UPDATE ran. With the fix, the second caller received b, one UPDATE ran, and the committed row contained b.
findings.interpretation: The original gather call created the task that lost its defaults. Its return sample in update_or_create led through _create_or_get after a conflicting INSERT. That path fetched the existing row and returned it with the creator’s value. The corrected path applies the waiting caller’s defaults. Aligning the two initial reads let the opposite caller win and produced the same role-dependent behavior.
findings.limits: The missing-row race depends on scheduling. In the default-pool runs the second caller saw the existing row and updated it normally. PostgreSQL readbacks and statement logs establish the committed value and write count. The Python stack identifies the caller and ORM branch.

findings_zh.observation: 两个异步调用同时为同一商品键指定不同值。未创建行的一方成功返回了另一方的值，提交的数据也漏掉了本次更新。
findings_zh.interpretation: PostgreSQL 日志记录插入参数、回滚和实际 UPDATE。上游回归同时覆盖相同列、不同列及 get_or_create；另用原生 SQL 验证更新语义。
findings_zh.limits: 并发调度影响是否遇到插入冲突。另一个原帖程序复制了旧算法，修复后仍演示旧结果。Python 栈无法独立判定数据库中的提交顺序。

cases.contribution: The join identifies the gather caller whose defaults were lost and traces its task to the conflict-handling path that returned the competing caller's value.
cases.contribution_zh: 拼接确定了 gather 中哪一个调用者的默认值丢失，并将它的任务追溯到返回竞争方数据的冲突处理路径。

cases.title: A Node DNS error omits the awaiting read call
cases.title_zh: 在 Node 22.2.0 上原样执行报告中的 ESM 文件

findings.observation: On Node 22.2.0, all three ordinary runs and all three runs with native async stacks enabled reported ENOTFOUND without the application’s read call on line 10.
findings.interpretation: In all three traced runs, CoroPerf matched the socket error to the rejection of the same read Promise and recovered its application call on line 10. In all three wrapped controls, AggregateError printed the same line.
findings.limits: The report used Windows x64. The Linux x64 run used the same Node release, the local resolver, and a probe that returned the original Promise.

findings_zh.observation: 在 Node 22.2.0 上原样执行报告中的 ESM 文件。三个普通进程和三个显式开启原生异步栈的进程均只报告 DNS 的 ENOTFOUND，缺少调用 read 的第 10 行。
findings_zh.interpretation: 定向采集把同一个 Error 的套接字发出事件连到 read Promise 的拒绝，再按该 Promise 的实例编号找到第 10 行。三次均吻合。按报告中的建议在 await 处包裹 AggregateError，三次原生日志也都出现该行；环回成功读取的三个进程正常退出。
findings_zh.limits: 报告平台为 Windows x64，此处使用同版 Linux x64 官方构建与本机系统解析器。探针包装 read 并返回原 Promise，事件关系来自该进程内的 WeakMap 对象标识。

cases.contribution: The default diagnostic omits reader.read() on line 10. In three stock Inspector runs with async ancestry enabled, the debugger shows the DNS connect from line 4 and still omits the later read. The matched read Promise reconnects line 10 to the error.
cases.contribution_zh: 默认异常栈缺少第 10 行的 reader.read()。三次开启异步归属的原生 Inspector 对照都看到了第 4 行的 DNS connect，却依然缺少后续的 read。匹配读取 Promise 后，CoroPerf 把第 10 行接回出错现场。

cases.title: Nested Playwright steps lose the outer page-object method from an assertion stack
cases.title_zh: 原报告的测试和 Page Object 在真实浏览器中因颜色断言失败，基线异常丢失外层 shouldBeCorrect

findings.observation: The original test failed its color assertion in a real browser, but the ordinary error omitted the outer shouldBeCorrect call.
findings.interpretation: Matching the actual step Promises across three error observations recovered the nested methods, and the upstream await change in raceAgainstDeadline restored the outer call in the native stack. The two inner steps had identical error stacks. The native IDs of their returned Promises identify separate calls on lines 18 and 19.
findings.limits: The page response was deterministic and local. Step ownership was recorded separately from physical callback stacks.

findings_zh.observation: 原报告的测试和 Page Object 在真实浏览器中因颜色断言失败，基线异常丢失外层 shouldBeCorrect。
findings_zh.interpretation: 按实际 step 返回 Promise 核对三次错误观测，恢复外层及嵌套方法；只应用上游 raceAgainstDeadline 的 await 改动后，原生错误栈也能显示外层调用。
findings_zh.limits: 请求使用确定性的本地页面响应，原断言仍按预期失败；step 归属需要专用边界，物理回调栈与 step 树分别保留。

cases.contribution: The affected runner's assertion stack omits its outer page-object method. Matching the returned step Promises recovers shouldBeCorrect and separates two inner step launches with identical error stacks.
cases.contribution_zh: 受影响版本的断言栈缺少外层页面对象方法。匹配各 test.step 返回的 Promise 后，可以找回 shouldBeCorrect，并区分异常栈完全相同的两次内层调用。

cases.title: Await and catch expose different Knex query stacks
cases.title_zh: 启用 Bluebird 长栈后，两条真实缺表查询均返回 42P01；直接 await 的错误没有 test1，链式 catch 再抛出的错误保留 test2 的查询行

findings.observation: With Bluebird long stacks enabled, both missing-table queries returned 42P01, but only the chained catch and rethrow preserved its application query line.
findings.interpretation: The logged continuations traced to test1 line 5 and test2 line 13. The directly awaited error stopped at Builder.Target.then and process._tickCallback, while the catch path retained test2.
findings.limits: Upstream did not confirm a cause. The Linux replay establishes stack visibility, not deliberate truncation by Knex or the maintainer’s Bluebird settings.

findings_zh.observation: 启用 Bluebird 长栈后，两条真实缺表查询均返回 42P01；直接 await 的错误没有 test1，链式 catch 再抛出的错误保留 test2 的查询行。
findings_zh.interpretation: coroPerf 将两个日志样本分别连到 test1 第 5 行和 test2 第 13 行创建的继续执行任务。直接 await 的错误本身止于 Builder.Target.then 和 process._tickCallback，链式栈另有 Builder 的 catch 转接及 test2。配置对照解释了本地为何能同时得到发帖者与维护者的观测。
findings_zh.limits: 维护者在公开评论中未确认根因。记录证明栈的可见差异以及打印错误时的任务归属；没有证据表明 Knex 主动截断错误，或表明维护者机器上 Bluebird 的实际配置。上游报告使用 macOS，本地为 Linux。

cases.contribution: Even with Bluebird long-stack traces enabled, direct await omits the test1 query line. Matching each query continuation reconnects the database error to test1 or test2.
cases.contribution_zh: 开启 Bluebird 长栈后，直接 await 的异常栈还是缺少 test1 的查询行。拼回各查询续体的创建栈后，数据库报错可以分别归到 test1 和 test2。

cases.title: An undefined binding hides the Knex query-builder call site
cases.title_zh: 在初报 MySQL 5.6 环境和后续 PostgreSQL 方言上，公开的原始路由在预编译时丢失调用行

findings.observation: The public route lost its caller during query compilation on both MySQL and PostgreSQL, while wrapper tracing recovered the builder call on line 22 of the published callback.
findings.interpretation: Each rejection mapped to a promise created on line 21 and passed through its dialect’s QueryCompiler.toSQL; valid bindings read back row 17, while invalid bindings sent no target SELECT.
findings.limits: The published SQLite callback used replacement database factories. The private helper and exact PostgreSQL version were unavailable, and replication was not tested.

findings_zh.observation: 在初报 MySQL 5.6 环境和后续 PostgreSQL 方言上，公开的原始路由在预编译时丢失调用行。报告者的路由加 wrapper 追踪，恢复关闭评论中公开回调的第 22 行。
findings_zh.interpretation: coroPerf 将两个未处理拒绝各自绑定到公开程序第 21 行创建的 Promise，异常经过 相应方言的 QueryCompiler.toSQL、路由和 Target.then。第 22 行的 builder 调用由 Knex 配置对照独立确认。另一组按截图执行三秒定时器与 FIRST 查询；有效绑定分别读回 reader/writer 行 17，无效绑定没有发送目标 SELECT。
findings_zh.limits: 关闭评论提供 SQLite 调用程序，此处原样保留回调并替换数据库工厂。定时器调用可见，私有 getRow 与 sql.ts 未公开，helper 为本地实现。复开的 PostgreSQL 实际版本未知，两库在同一实例，未模拟复制。

cases.contribution: The rejection stack starts in Knex query compilation. Matching the rejected Promise recovers the runCase dispatch line before the await boundary.
cases.contribution_zh: 拒绝发生时的栈起于 Knex 查询编译。匹配被拒绝的 Promise 后，可以补回 await 之前 runCase 发起查询的代码行。

cases.title: MySQL’s duplicate-key error loses the TypeORM insert caller
cases.title_zh: MySQL 拒绝第二次插入相同主键时，父提交的 QueryFailedError 栈从 Query.onResult 开始，缺失调用 repository.insert 的 myNamedFunction1234

findings.observation: When MySQL rejected a second insert with the same primary key, the old QueryFailedError stack began at Query.onResult and omitted myNamedFunction1234.
findings.interpretation: The upstream regression linked the error to the named function’s returned promise, and throwing from query’s catch restored InsertQueryBuilder.execute and the second insert’s call site. The sampled stack is the rejected Promise’s saved error stack, read in Chai’s callback. The callback’s execution ID is separate from the Promise ID.
findings.limits: The public regression used a duplicate key. Both builds returned 1062/23000 and retained the original row; promise identity was verified for the test function.

findings_zh.observation: MySQL 拒绝第二次插入相同主键时，父提交的 QueryFailedError 栈从 Query.onResult 开始，缺失调用 repository.insert 的 myNamedFunction1234。
findings_zh.interpretation: 上游 #11273 指向 #11271，合并的 #12056 续接该提案。真实 Mocha 回归的旧栈定位到 MySQL 回调内包装错误；async_hooks 创建栈和 V8 对象等值核对将该异常追到 myNamedFunction1234 返回的同一 Promise。合并后在 query 的 catch 内抛错，原生栈恢复 InsertQueryBuilder.execute 与第二次 insert 的调用行。
findings_zh.limits: 本次使用合并 PR 的公开重复主键回归；原帖描述的是查询错误和丢失调用栈。两版本均返回 1062/23000，首行保持 Incubus，独立对照和服务重启均确认持久化结果相同。同一对象证据限于交给 Chai 的测试函数 Promise，回调在另一 Promise 中执行。

cases.contribution: The affected MySQL error stack starts in driver code and omits myNamedFunction1234. The returned Promise identity recovers that initiator and distinguishes it from the test callback reading the error.
cases.contribution_zh: 受影响版本的 MySQL 异常栈起于驱动代码，缺少 myNamedFunction1234。用返回 Promise 的身份拼回发起者，并能把它和读取该异常的测试回调区分开。

cases.title: Cursor prefetch delays delivery of rows that are already available
cases.title_zh: PostgreSQL 14 和 asyncpg 0.29.0 上同时执行两个五行游标，只让其中一个后端在第三行等待

findings.observation: With row three held on PostgreSQL 14, asyncpg 0.29.0 delivered nothing before release at prefetch 4 or 50 and delivered rows 1 and 2 at prefetch 1, while the other cursor returned all five.
findings.interpretation: Task stacks distinguished the initial batch fetch from the next single-row fetch, and protocol records showed a complete large DataRow could arrive before the application saw any row.
findings.limits: The report supplied no SQL or versions. A local cooperative lock controlled readiness, and stacks alone could not distinguish buffering from batch delivery.

findings_zh.observation: PostgreSQL 14 和 asyncpg 0.29.0 上同时执行两个五行游标，只让其中一个后端在第三行等待。prefetch=4 和默认值 50 都使应用在解锁前收到零行；prefetch=1 使应用先收到第 1、2 行。交换被阻塞的应用入口得到相同结果。同一时段另一个请求完整返回五行。
findings_zh.interpretation: coroPerf 把被阻塞的实例连回实际创建入口。四行模式停在 CursorIterator.__anext__ → _bind_exec；单行模式已交付两行，停在下一次 _exec。在同一版本的独立协议观测中，大行的第一条完整 DataRow 已交给未修改的 asyncpg 协议处理器，应用仍是零行。解锁后四行组先收到 PortalSuspended，随后才交付；默认 50 遇到五行结果的 CommandComplete 也能交付。16 字节小行对照在解锁前连整条 DataRow 都没到。设置 timeout 后抛出 TimeoutError，连接可复用，没有部分结果。
findings_zh.limits: 原帖给出游标 API 和所需行为，未指定 SQL、数据库、客户端版本或逐行延迟。本地选用发帖时已发布的客户端，用普通查询和一个协作锁稳定行的就绪顺序。这里只验证该版本游标的交付边界。观测器在协议处理器接收字节后记录已解码的报文类型、行号与长度；锁归属由服务端单独读取。单靠函数栈无法区分网络缓冲与客户端批量交付。

cases.contribution: The sample shows consume blocked in _bind_exec. Joining it to start_export identifies the export cursor task in the two-cursor performance control. Protocol records independently establish that rows had arrived before delivery to the application.
cases.contribution_zh: 物理栈看到 consume 等在 _bind_exec。把采样接回 start_export 后，可在双游标性能对照中确认等待的是导出游标任务。协议记录独立验证了数据行已到达而应用仍未收到。

cases.title: V8 CPU samples lose the launcher of a shared callee after await
cases.title_zh: 两个调用者共享同一个 CPU 热点，普通采样看不到发起者

findings.observation: On Node 24.18.0, 603 profile-only samples from three controlled runs showed the sharedService → busySpin path without either application launcher. Both callers had samples in every run.
findings.interpretation: CoroPerf assigned 579 profiled observations to the active runtime generation using the observed async-hooks enter/leave interval. Joining each observation to creation recovered launchProfile or launchInventory. Independent fixture timing and request labels agreed for all 579 samples, including the run with reversed execution order.
findings.limits: This is a two-caller adaptation of the missing asynchronous ancestry problem, using V8's CPU profiler on Linux. The report's fast-blocked-at watchdog and Node 20.5.1 environment were not replayed. Counts measure attribution, not collection overhead or production performance.

findings_zh.observation: Node 24.18.0 的三次普通 CPU 采样共有 603 个观测落在 sharedService 和 busySpin 中，均看不到两个应用发起者。每次运行都覆盖两个调用者。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 使用 async_hooks 记录的进入和离开区间，将 579 个 CPU 观测归到当时活跃的运行时实例，再拼接其创建栈，恢复 launchProfile 或 launchInventory。独立记录的请求标签和执行时间全部吻合，包括反转执行顺序的对照。
findings_zh.limits: 这是缺失异步调用来源的双入口改编实验，在 Linux 使用 V8 CPU profiler。原帖使用的 fast-blocked-at watchdog 和 Node 20.5.1 环境不在本次复现范围内。采样数量衡量归属正确性。

cases.contribution: The two callers share one sampled CPU stack after await. CoroPerf joins the active Promise generation to its creation so the same callee is attributed separately to launchProfile and launchInventory.
cases.contribution_zh: 两个调用者在 await 后的热点调用栈相同。CoroPerf 先确定当时活跃的 Promise 实例，再拼回其创建栈，把同一个被调用者分别连到 launchProfile 和 launchInventory。

cases.title: Identical hot-poll stacks hide the two callers delaying socket reads
cases.title_zh: 同一个 CPU 调用栈掩盖了拖慢读事件的两个发起者

findings.observation: In the stock Tokio 1.54.1 control, six Unix-socket reads on the shared runtime waited a median of 107.924 ms after the peer began writing. Moving the same 120 ms CPU poll to a separate runtime gave a median of 0.039 ms on six reads.
findings.interpretation: Both launch paths had identical physical function stacks after suspension and the same built-in TaskMeta spawn location. CoroPerf assigned each hot stack to the active Tokio task by its observed poll interval. The creation stack recovered launch_profile or launch_inventory in all 24 verified observations across two batches, including reversed-order runs. The stack snapshots carried neither a task ID nor a phase label.
findings.limits: This is a local, bounded adaptation of the scheduling issue with one asynchronous I/O worker and controlled CPU slices. Read delay is a socket readiness-to-read proxy. The experiment compares two runtime layouts.

findings_zh.observation: Tokio 1.54.1 的普通采集对照中，CPU 和 I/O 共用运行时时，从对端开始写到完成读取，6 次 Unix socket 读取的中位延迟为 107.924 毫秒。将同样的 120 毫秒 CPU poll 放到单独运行时后，6 次读取的中位延迟为 0.039 毫秒。
findings_zh.interpretation: 挂起后，两条发起路径的物理函数栈完全相同，Tokio 自带的 TaskMeta 也指向同一行 spawn。CoroPerf 根据实际 poll 区间确定采样属于哪个任务，再接回创建栈。两轮共 24 次观测均恢复了正确的 launch_profile 或 launch_inventory，反转执行顺序后仍然一致。采样本身未携带任务 ID 或实验分组。
findings_zh.limits: 这是对上游调度问题的本地受控改编，使用一个异步 I/O worker 和固定长度的 CPU 片段。对端开始写入到读取完成的差值用于近似读取调度延时。

cases.title: A dispatcher switch hides the exception’s tail caller
cases.title_zh: 切换调度器后，异常栈失去尾调用的调用者

findings.observation: With Kotlin 1.3.50 and kotlinx.coroutines 1.3.3, the dispatch-switch example omits callThrowableSuspendFun even with stock recovery enabled. In the two-caller extension, both exceptions have identical stacks, and the official DebugProbes live dumps also omit both tail callers.
findings.interpretation: The Kotlin compiler forwards the continuation through the tail callers without creating a wrapper state machine. CoroPerf records the still-live caller stack at DispatchedCoroutine construction and reads the same Job from the throwing continuation on the worker. Across two batches, all 16 joins agreed with an independent check of the Job and original exception, including trials with reversed launch order.
findings.limits: The displayed stacks are from the controlled two-caller extension. The original tail-call loss was replayed separately on the same versions. The non-tail source variant retained its wrapper with stock recovery. The stock comparison covers these historical releases.

findings_zh.observation: 在 Kotlin 1.3.50 和 kotlinx.coroutines 1.3.3 上，开启自带异常栈恢复后，切换调度器的例子仍缺少 callThrowableSuspendFun。在双调用者改编中，两次异常栈完全相同，官方 DebugProbes 在抛出异常前的实时转储里也没有这两个尾调用者。
findings_zh.interpretation: 编译器让尾调用者直接把 continuation 传给下一级，不生成独立的包装状态机。CoroPerf 在 DispatchedCoroutine 构造时记录仍在栈上的调用者，然后在 worker 抛出异常的 continuation 中取出同一个 Job。两批实验的 16 次拼接均通过 Job 和原始异常的独立核对，也覆盖了交换发起顺序的试验。
findings_zh.limits: 页面展示双调用者受控改编的记录。上游报告的尾调用栈缺失已经在相同版本上另行复现。将原始代码改为非尾调用后，自带的异常栈恢复可以保留调用者。对照结论限于本次测试的历史版本。

cases.contribution: The same worker exception stack can come from profileCaller or inventoryCaller. The Job taken from the throwing continuation links that exception to the correct caller at DispatchedCoroutine creation.
cases.contribution_zh: 同一个 worker 异常栈可能来自 profileCaller 或 inventoryCaller。从抛出异常的 continuation 取到的 Job，把异常接回 DispatchedCoroutine 创建时的正确调用者。

cases.title: Who started the fibers waiting with no stack trace?
cases.title_zh: 只有 WAITING、没有调用栈的 fiber 是谁启动的？

findings.observation: In the reported Play application on Cats Effect 3.3.0, the stock /dump/fibers endpoint showed four WAITING rows with no frames in the four-worker configuration. Full stock tracing left the same rows blank. A separate waiting fiber had frames for the periodic dump.
findings.interpretation: CoroPerf matched the actual IOFiber passed to the stock monitor with that object's wait registration and construction. The recorded creator edge leads to loader.AppComponents.dispatcher at AppLoader.scala:32 for all ten blank rows across three runs. The traced periodic dump fiber leads separately to AppLoader.scala:36.
findings.limits: The page shows all four blank rows from one original-app capture. Repeats use four and two workers on the same archived releases. The execution samples record wait registration, and the matching stock dump confirms those fibers later appeared as WAITING. The experiment identifies their origin in this application.

findings_zh.observation: 报告中的 Play 应用使用 Cats Effect 3.3.0。配置四个 worker 时，原生 /dump/fibers 显示四条没有栈帧的 WAITING 记录，开启完整追踪后仍然如此。另一个等待中的定时转储 fiber 有自己的栈帧。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 用传给监控器的实际 IOFiber 对象，把等待登记和对象构造连起来，再沿记录的创建者边向上查。三轮里 10 条无栈 WAITING 记录都接回 AppLoader.scala:32 的 loader.AppComponents.dispatcher。带栈的定时转储 fiber 则接回 AppLoader.scala:36。
findings_zh.limits: 页面展示原始应用一次采集中的全部四条无栈记录。复跑配置了四个或两个 worker，均使用同一组历史版本。执行栈采于等待登记，后续原生转储核对同一对象确实出现在 WAITING 列表中。实验确定这些 fiber 在该应用中的来源。

cases.contribution: The stock monitor gives four WAITING rows with no frames. CoroPerf joins each worker's wait registration to its creation and then to the application's dispatcher initialization at AppLoader.scala:32.
cases.contribution_zh: 原生监控器显示四条没有栈帧的 WAITING 记录。CoroPerf 把各 worker 的等待登记接回自己的创建栈，再接回应用在 AppLoader.scala:32 初始化 Dispatcher 的位置。

cases.title: Which async callers submitted the blocking jobs with long queue waits?
cases.title_zh: 排队慢的阻塞任务来自哪个异步调用者？

findings.observation: With two async producers and one blocking worker, the median p99 queue wait across two stock-tracing runs per layout was 229.475 ms for the default queue and 1,769.953 ms for the sharded queue. Both routes had the same worker function stack, blocking submit location, and async producer spawn location. Stock tracing distinguished task IDs and recorded their parent IDs.
findings.interpretation: CoroPerf attributes each ID-free worker snapshot to the blocking span active on that thread. It follows the blocking task's creation and recorded async producer edge to a launch_profile or launch_inventory frame in the producer's creation stack. All 1,036 snapshots across four captures agreed with independently checked JoinHandle IDs and worker intervals. The displayed sharded examples waited 1,880.170 ms and 1,999.255 ms before execution.
findings.limits: This is a controlled two-producer extension with 4,400 jobs per run on the reported Tokio revision, using the original tracing interface. The displayed records are the longest sampled wait for each caller in one run. Queue wait is measured from submission to the start of the blocking code.

findings_zh.observation: 两个异步生产者共用一个 blocking worker。每种队列配置做两次原生 tracing 对照，p99 排队时间的中位数在默认队列为 229.475 毫秒、分片队列为 1,769.953 毫秒。两条路径的 worker 函数栈、阻塞提交行和异步生产者启动行相同。原生 tracing 能区分任务 ID 并记录父任务 ID。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 用 worker 线程上活跃的阻塞 span，为没有任务 ID 的执行样本确定归属，再沿阻塞任务的创建栈和创建者边接回 launch_profile 或 launch_inventory。四次采集的 1,036 个样本均通过 JoinHandle ID 和 worker 执行区间的独立核对。页面展示的两个分片队列任务分别在执行前等待了 1,880.170 和 1,999.255 毫秒。
findings_zh.limits: 这是在报告指定 Tokio 版本上的双生产者受控实验。每轮提交 4,400 个任务，使用 Tokio 自带的 tracing 接口。页面选择了一轮中两条路径各自等待最长的已采样任务。排队时间从提交算到阻塞代码开始执行。

cases.title: The original caller disappears across a detached Asio spawn
cases.title_zh: Asio 的 detached spawn 隐去了原始调用者

findings.observation: Both timer resumptions have the same physical function stack in symbolized GDB. Asio's caller_ links reach async_b and then the co_spawn_entry_point, whose caller link is null. Handler tracking reports the shared library submission and timer operations.
findings.interpretation: From the stripped executable, registers and stack bytes, CoroPerf uses instruction dataflow to identify the live async_c frame. It joins the sample to async_c construction, then follows its observed creator to the creation stack of async_b. The earlier stack recovers launch_profile or launch_inventory on all eight samples across four trials, including reversed launch order.
findings.limits: The timer adaptation uses GCC 11, Boost.Asio 1.83 and Linux x86-64. The probe locations are selected for the test and the recovered PCs receive function names after reconstruction from the matching debug ELF. The upstream application ran on macOS arm64.

findings_zh.observation: 带完整调试信息的 GDB 中，两次定时器恢复的物理函数栈相同。Asio 的 caller_ 从 async_c 连到 async_b，再到 co_spawn_entry_point，此处的 caller 指针为空。原生 handler tracking 能看到共用的库提交位置和定时器操作。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 从去符号的可执行文件、寄存器和栈字节入手，用指令数据流识别活跃的 async_c 帧。先把样本接回 async_c 的创建，再沿创建者边接回 async_b 的创建栈。四轮共八个样本都找回了正确的 launch_profile 或 launch_inventory，交换发起顺序后结果仍然一致。
findings_zh.limits: 这是 GCC 11、Boost.Asio 1.83 和 Linux x86-64 下的定时器改编。采样点由实验指定，函数名来自重建完成后对照带调试信息的 ELF。上游应用运行于 macOS arm64。

cases.contribution: Asio's live awaiter chain ends at the detached entry. Instruction dataflow recovers the timer's active instance, and its two recorded creation edges lead back to launch_profile or launch_inventory.
cases.contribution_zh: Asio 的实时 awaiter 链止于 detached 入口。指令数据流恢复定时器唤醒的实例，两处创建关系将它接回 launch_profile 或 launch_inventory。

cases.title: The bridge Future is cancelled while its asyncio Task is still cleaning up
cases.title_zh: 跨线程的 Future 已取消，asyncio Task 仍在清理

findings.observation: Both bridge Futures reported cancellation while their Tasks were still pending in cleanup. On 3.10.12 neither Task had entered cleanup at the first loop checkpoint; on 3.14.3 both had. Stock debug traceback identified submitters while the handles were queued. After delivery, the Task traceback and coroutine origin omitted both submitters. The 3.14.3 call graph showed the same cleanup for both Tasks.
findings.interpretation: CoroPerf records the two actual objects passed to _chain_future. The Task snapshot links to its construction record, and the bridge Future links that construction across threads to launch_profile or launch_inventory. Independent Future and Task object checks agreed for all 16 observations across both releases and both launch orders.
findings.limits: The displayed evidence is a controlled two-caller Linux replay on CPython 3.10.12. The same test exercises the checkpoint and diagnostics on 3.14.3. The fixture holds cleanup open for observation and then verifies that both Tasks finish cancelling.

findings_zh.observation: 两个外层 Future 都已显示取消，而内层 Task 还在清理。在第一次事件循环检查点，3.10.12 中两个 Task 都尚未进入清理，3.14.3 中两个都已进入。回调仍在队列时，原生调试信息包含提交者。回调处理后，Task 创建栈和 coroutine origin 都缺少提交者，3.14.3 的调用图也只显示相同的清理路径。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 记录 _chain_future 实际收到的两个对象。Task 快照接回同一 Task 的创建栈，再通过外层 Future 跨线程接回 launch_profile 或 launch_inventory。两个版本、两种发起顺序共 16 次观测，均通过 Future 和 Task 对象身份的独立核对。
findings_zh.limits: 页面展示 CPython 3.10.12 上的 Linux 双调用者实验。相同测试也在 3.14.3 上核对了取消时间点与原生诊断。实验暂时挂起清理以便观测，之后释放并确认两个 Task 均完成取消。

cases.contribution: Both cancelled bridge Futures conceal the same pending cleanup path. The recorded Task-to-Future object relationship connects each Task snapshot to the original cross-thread submitter.
cases.contribution_zh: 两个外层 Future 已取消，内层 Task 都停在同一段清理路径。通过记录下来的 Task 与 Future 对象关系，各自的清理快照可以接回真正的跨线程提交者。
